rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: Hey, can we talk about the dishes? They've been piling up all week and I wanted to check in before it becomes a thing.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: Sure, but I did them Tuesday night. I don't think it's fair to act like I never touch them.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: Tuesday was five days ago. I've done every load since then and I'm getting tired of keeping score.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: So now I'm the villain because I didn't get to it fast enough? I have a life outside this kitchen too.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: I AM SO SICK OF BEING THE ONLY ONE WHO CARES ABOUT THIS HOUSE! I CANNOT DO THIS BY MYSELF ANYMORE!

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: Wow. Impressive speech. You really do love playing the martyr, don't you.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: I don't want to be the martyr. I just... I wanted us to be a team, and I don't feel like one right now.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: I don't want that either. I don't want us to be like this. I'm actually scared we're breaking something here.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: I don't want that either. Can we just stop and figure out a system together? Something that actually works for both of us?

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: Yeah. Let's start over. I'm sorry I got so defensive — I do want to fix this with you.

rows.text: Yeah. Let's start over. I'm sorry I got so defensive — I do want to fix this with you.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: Hey, I looked at the credit card statement tonight. Can we go over it?

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: Sure. I know it's higher than usual, but most of that was the car repair.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: The car was six hundred. There's another nine hundred I can't place.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: Some was groceries, some was your mom's birthday gift. I didn't hide anything.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: I'm not saying you hid it. I'm saying we agreed to talk before spending like that.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: We talked about it in the car. You just weren't listening, like always.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: LIKE ALWAYS? I AM THE ONLY ONE IN THIS HOUSE WHO EVEN LOOKS AT THE BILLS!

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: Please don't yell at me. I'm right here, I can hear you.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: Forget it. Clearly budgeting is beneath you. I'll just handle it, like everything else.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: That's not fair. I'm trying, and you talk to me like I'm a child.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: You're right. I'm sorry. That came out way harsher than I meant.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: Thank you. Can we just sit down Sunday and do it together, no phones?

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: Yeah. Sunday. I'd like that. And I'll bring the good coffee.

rows.speaker: Speaker C
rows.text: Okay, dinner's in ten minutes. Who's setting the table tonight?

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: Not me, I did it yesterday. And the day before, actually.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: Then it's my turn. Grab the plates for me, would you?

rows.speaker: Speaker C
rows.text: Also, someone left the milk out again. All afternoon.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: Why do you always assume it's me? Maybe ask Dad for once.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: It was probably me, honestly. I made coffee around two.

rows.speaker: Speaker C
rows.text: That's the third time this week. It's not funny anymore.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: OH MY GOD, IT'S MILK! WHY IS EVERYTHING IN THIS HOUSE A CRISIS?

rows.speaker: Speaker C
rows.text: Don't shout at me. I'm tired and I'm just asking for a little help.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: Hey! Don't talk to your mother like that, and don't drag me into it either!

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: Fine. Sorry. I'm just sick of getting blamed for everything.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: I know. I snapped too. Let's all just reset, okay?

rows.speaker: Speaker C
rows.text: Reset. Plates, forks, and somebody put the milk in the fridge.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: On it. And for the record, I'm making the garlic bread.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: Now we're talking. Best part of the week, right here.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: Okay, let's start. First item: the March launch timeline.

rows.speaker: Speaker C
rows.text: Engineering's on track. Integration tests finish by the twentieth.

rows.speaker: Speaker D
rows.text: Marketing needs final screenshots by the fifteenth, or the press kit slips.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: Tight, but doable. I'll have design prioritize the screenshots.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: Good. Second item: the support backlog is up thirty percent.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: I'll pull the top ten tickets and send them round this afternoon.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: Third item, budget. Finance wants every team to trim eight percent.

rows.speaker: Speaker D
rows.text: Eight percent? We already cut the contractor budget last quarter.

rows.speaker: Speaker C
rows.text: We could delay the second hire until June. That covers most of it.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: That's one option. What about the conference sponsorship?

rows.speaker: Speaker D
rows.text: We signed that in December. Backing out costs almost as much as going.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: So we delay my hire again? That's the third time this year.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: Nobody's decided anything. We're just listing options.

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: THEN LIST A DIFFERENT ONE! MY TEAM IS DROWNING AND EVERYONE HERE KNOWS IT!

rows.speaker: Speaker C
rows.text: Okay. Let's take that seriously. Can we table this and come back with real numbers?

rows.speaker: Speaker A
rows.text: Yeah. Sorry, everyone. That was out of line. Real numbers by Thursday.

rows.speaker: Speaker B
rows.text: Thursday works. Thanks, everyone. That's all for today.
